claim_boundary: This file records candidate provenance for the RT-DBSCAN paper datasets.
It does not claim that exact paper input files are present in this repository.
It does not authorize exact paper dataset reproduction or paper-performance claims.

paper.title: RT-DBSCAN: Accelerating DBSCAN using Ray Tracing Hardware

author_artifact.source_observation: hostCode.cpp reads av[1] and contains commented local developer paths for 3D_iono.txt, porto.txt, and 3droad_full.csv; the repository does not package those files.

paper_datasets.name: Porto

paper_parameter_hints: Impact-of-epsilon study: first 1M points, minPts=100, varying epsilon.
Dataset-size study: first n points, epsilon=0.5, minPts=1000.
